tei:div.tei:p:
Halleluyah: Praise the Name of the Lord, give praise, servants of the Lord who stand in the House of the Lord, in the courtyards of the House of God. Halleluyah for the Lord is good, sing to His Name for it is delightful. For the Lord chose Jacob for Himself, Israel as His own possession. For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Master is greater than all the deities. All that the Lord wills He does in heaven and on earth, in the seas and all the depths. He brings clouds up from the end of the earth, makes lightning with the rain, brings the wind forth from His treasuries. He slew the firstborn of Egypt from man to beast. He sent signs and wonders in your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants. He smote numerous peoples and slew mighty kings, Sihon, King of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan, and all the realms of Canaan, and gave their land as an
inheritance, an inheritance to His people Israel. O Lord, Thy Name endures for ever, O Lord, Thy memory from generation to generation. For the Lord judges His people and has pity on His servants. The idols of the nations are of silver and gold, the work of human hands. They have a mouth and do not speak, they have eyes and do not see. They have ears and do not hear, nor is there any breath in their mouth. Like them will be those who made them, everyone who trusts in them. O House of Israel, bless the Lord, O House of Aaron, bless the Lord, O House of Levi, praise the Lord, O those that fear the Lord, bless the Lord. Blessed be the Lord from Zion, He Who dwells in Jerusalem. Halleluyah.
